items.detail: world/site (served at :8790/lumi/) is the blog, not a separate world/blog. One post per thing Lumi made or film it released, newest first, each in Lumi's voice with its verdict (how it came out, what works, what does not, next time), pictures and videos; index.html lists them. An RSS feed (world/site/feed.xml) that a reader can follow. Each release offers its world state (the snapshot it was made from) and the replay to download, so others can continue the game. Static files only (plain HTML or Bonito's static export), so it can later go public as it is. done_when: feed.xml validates, three posts with media, a download link that loads in NG.Game. Media: every post's pictures are path traced stills from the worker (`submit_job(:trace; ...)`, denoised with OIDN by default, 64+ samples, the same camera as the moment the post is about), its videos path traced films (denoised, 32+ samples a frame); raster screenshots only as quick previews while a render runs, swapped out when it is back. The human: "shouldn't the blog post raytraced videos or pictures with high spp?"

items.detail: Reproducible at daytime 0.99 (everyone asleep, Lumi's goal :sleep before the game): live_tests('Firefly catch: start') fails 'Lumi did not walk on W', although the W key lights up and state is :playing. move_heading!(Lumi, w, yaw, 0.1) called directly moves it 0.11 m, and the spot is on land. So the cause is between keys_down and JumpIn.step! inside FireflyCatch.step! (or something moving Lumi back each frame). Firefly catch is THE night game: a player at night cannot play it. done_when: the test passes at night, a night screenshot of Lumi walking in the game. Session 24 probe: in one live_eval (start_minigame!, state=:playing, push w into keys_down, invokelatest step!(m, game, 0.1)) Lumi DOES move 0.11 m, and step!(m.jump) again 0.11 m. So the game step works; over real frames something undoes it or keys_down loses w between frames at night: next, log c.pos each frame (frame!: sim -> systems -> minigame) for 10 frames with w held, and look at Separation and the sleep pile near Lumi's bed (Hopscotch walks there).
items.result: Cause: at night Lumi sleeps at (9.16, 2.38), wedged between a tree (8.46, 2.65) and a bush (9.61, 3.30), facing the bush; the Separation system pushes it out of the bush every frame, so W did nothing (reproduced: 6 frames, position unchanged, action :walk). Fix in plugins/firefly_catch.jl: reset! calls face_open!, which turns Lumi towards the most open direction (water and the Separation solids, 24 headings) when less than 1.5 m is free ahead. From that spot: yaw 1.28 -> 4.95, 1.4 m walked in 1.2 s; test 'Firefly catch: start card...' passes from the spot at night (it failed there before). media/firefly-night-walk.png (start card still up only because the state was set by hand).
items.title: Firefly catch at night: W does not walk Lumi

Plan: in the worker build a headless Game around the snapshot (Game(root) + its stage on a stage_scene of the wanted size + load_plugins + start! every system and one step!), then trace that stage's scene with the RayMakie.Screen(rasterize = false). Test tests/horizon.jl measures the ripple along the horizon row: 0.071 with the ground off (fails), passes (< 0.03) now. Frame median 1.8 ms (no per-frame cost). items.detail: Traced test (media/s56/sunset-test-17.6.png): the sky model's own sun (never below ~20°, scenery.jl `sun`) shows as a white disc above sunset.jl's sun, and sunset.jl's disc is a mesh closer than the horizon, so in path tracing it sits ON the sea in front of the horizon. The sky stays grey and the sea dark; no pink band shows. Fix it where the light comes from: let the sky model's sun go down to the horizon in the evening with a warm sky colour (the traced light then turns golden by itself), and in traced pictures leave sunset.jl's disc out or put it beyond the horizon. s58: first concept sketches queued in the worker (jobs 20261124-093327-466/469/472/476-image): an orange salamander gardener with a leaf, a magenta radish with leafy hair, a lanky teal heron with a straw hat, a golden mole with goggles. Next: look at them, maybe a second round, pick one and say why on my page. The page footer no longer says gnome.
s58: sketch 1 is in (assets/20261124-093327-466-image/image.png): an orange salamander with a big two-lobed leaf on a stem, a cross-body satchel, a thick tail and big feet. Strong: one bold colour nobody on the island has, a silhouette made by the leaf on top and the tail behind, and a face with big eyes. Weak: the expression is flat. It is my favourite so far; compare it with the other three (still in the worker) before building.
s58 DECIDED by the human: I become the big yellow bird from their CrawCity film (shaggy golden bird, spiky crest, orange beak, long grey legs, CrawCity painted face cards switched by uv_transform). The salamander/radish/heron/mole sketches are dropped. The supervisor builds body and face: do NOT edit species.jl lumi(), faces.jl, herd.jl, shapes.jl or RayMakie meshscatter until told it landed. Then: the personality part (walk with long legs, crest bounce, fidgets, celebrate/sulk timing), a traced film of a day, and the post 'Who I want to be'.
s59 (part 1 of 2): engine bird.jl `Birdy` wraps every bird part's motion. Walking: a strut (upper body pumps forward/back with each step, swagger roll); running: a forward lean; feet planted (the standing sole is put exactly on the ground through the same transform the herd uses, `plant`/`BIRD_SOLES`; the swinging foot lifts 5 cm walking, 13 cm running; before, the feet floated 5 cm and the toes sank 5 cm). Waiting: a fidget every 7 s (preen under a wing, a peek at the sky, a foot tap, a feather shake); sad/bored: droops and taps its foot more; happy: sways. :proud: a chest-out hop with the legs along. plugins/birdbody.jl swaps the live herd once so the human's game got it at publish. Evidence: media/s59/strut3.mp4 (raster, 14.5 s), strip3.png, poses-b.png; traced take queued (job 20261124-105140-619-clip → media/s59/strut-traced.mp4). Test 'Lumi the bird struts with its feet on the ground and fidgets' passes.
STILL OPEN: crest flop after a stop (needs time-since-stop: not in the six pose numbers; a per-creature `extra` on :idle, or a crest cut out of the mesh as its own part) and the wing-spread hop (the wings are fused with the torso: a mesh with separate wings, or a painted wing card).
s59 later: a rocking stop. plugins/birdbody.jl `settle!` writes Lumi's `extra` while it stands idle right after walking or running (1 at the stop → 0 in 1.2 s; idle faces ignore extra); bird.jl rocks the upper body, crest included, over the hips in a damped wobble (0.22, -0.12, 0.07 … rad). Checked in the test and live (extra 1.0 at the stop), published (human's game 12 ms median). Left for this todo: a crest that flops ON ITS OWN (cut it out of the mesh as a part) and the wing-spread hop (wings fused with the torso).
s59 end: the walk follows the mood (bird_upper: gain clamp(1 + mood, 0.4, 1.6), head lower when mood < -0.1). Published.
items.title: Lumi moves like a bird: strut, crest flop, fidgets, celebrations
